event_selections.event: bilingual/code glitch transition: clean shield text → glitch burst with EXECUTION/执行指令
event_selections.selection_rationale: Frames n2100-n2159 show a transition from clean white shield with 'Though We are' text (70s) through a cyan-line transition (71s) to a colorful glitch burst with 'EXECUTION!' in red + '执行指令' in Chinese + code interface elements (Feeling Index progress bar, timestamp, glitch particles) at 72s. This demonstrates bilingual (EN+ZH) text with code/interface relations and glitch effects.

event_selections.event: lyric scrolling with highlight in music player UI
event_selections.distinction_addressed: real lyric scrolling/highlight/overlap versus tutorial controls
event_selections.selection_rationale: Frames n500-n574 show a static music player UI (vinyl disc, anime character background, progress bar) with Chinese lyrics scrolling on the right side. Current line is bold/white, previous lines are gray. New lines appear at bottom, old lines move up. This is real lyric scrolling/highlight, not tutorial controls — the UI is the content, not a demonstration of controls.

event_selections.event: shape-to-text morph: blobs/circles ↔ word glyphs with background color change
event_selections.selection_rationale: Frames n270-n419 show a clear shape-to-text morph: 5 white blobs (9s) → 'TRUST' text (10s) → 5 white circles (11s) → pink wavy line on blue (12s, DECEPTION transition) → 'SINCERE' on orange (14s). The 'change' is not a simple text swap but a morph between geometric shapes (circles/blobs) and text glyphs, with background color changing per word. This is a true shape/stroke morph, not just scale or mask.

constructions.name: bilingual/code glitch burst
constructions.observed_pixels: black bg with scan lines; white shield with 'Though We are' (clean) → cyan transition lines → RGB glitch particles + 'EXECUTION!' red + '执行指令' ZH + 'Feeling Index' progress bar + timestamp; monospace/code font

proposal.glyph_mapping: EN: monospace/code font, glitch-distorted; ZH: clean sans-serif; labels: small monospace
proposal.instances_groups: main text group (EN+ZH) + interface group (progress bar, timestamp, labels) + particle group (RGB glitch)
proposal.baseline_geometry: main text: centered, large; labels: small, positioned around main; particles: full-frame scatter
material_passes: glitch: RGB particle scatter + text distortion
proposal.masks_compositing_order: bg → scan lines → shield (clean) / particles (glitch) → main text → interface elements → spaced credits
proposal.effect_scope: per-scene (clean vs glitch are distinct states); particles are full-frame
proposal.local_global_time: local: scene cut at ~1s; global: sequential scenes
proposal.deterministic_randomness: particle positions are semi-random (glitch effect); text content is deterministic

constructions.minimal_counterexample: a single static bilingual text (no glitch, no interface) would be too narrow; the glitch + interface combination is the key feature
constructions.lyric_emotion_fit: fits energetic, digital, futuristic lyrics; glitch implies disruption/error; bilingual adds cultural layer; avoid calm/organic lyrics (glitch too aggressive)
constructions.image_relation: text is primary content; interface elements frame the text; particles add motion/energy; no characters/MMD
constructions.avoid_cases: do not use for minimalist/clean aesthetic (glitch too busy); do not use for non-digital themes (code interface implies tech)
constructions.readability_risk: glitch distortion reduces readability; RGB particles may obscure text; monospace font is readable but small labels may be hard to see

proposal.instances_groups: lyric group (scrolling lines) + UI group (title, credits, progress, watermark) + scene group (character, vinyl)

material_passes: vinyl: purple/blue disc with gold center
proposal.masks_compositing_order: bg character → vinyl disc → lyric lines (gray→white) → UI labels → progress bar → watermark
proposal.effect_scope: lyrics: per-line (highlight shifts); UI: persistent; scene: persistent
proposal.local_global_time: lyrics: continuous scroll (~1 line per 2-3s); UI: persistent; scene: persistent

constructions.minimal_counterexample: a static lyric card (no scroll, no highlight) would be too narrow; the scroll + highlight is the key feature
